abilities.name: Rally Cry
abilities.description: As a Basic Action, choose yourself or an allied Digimon and spend 3 Hope to remove one stack of any status effect currently affecting them.

abilities.name: Rally the Team
abilities.description: Rally Cry can now target up to 3 allied Digimon at once instead of just one.

abilities.name: Heart of the Team
abilities.description: Rally Cry no longer costs Hope to use.

abilities.name: Never Too Late
abilities.description: Once per encounter, when an allied Digimon would enter Egg State, you may immediately spend 10 Hope to prevent it. That Digimon instead stabilizes at In-Training Stage with 1 HP.

abilities.name: Clean Sweep
abilities.description: Rally Cry now removes all stacks of all negative status effects affecting the chosen Digimon.

abilities.name: Talk Them Down
abilities.description: As a Basic Action, make a Tame check against DN 15 targeting a Dark Digivolution. On a success, it calms, forcibly dedigivolving back to its Default Stage, and it leaves the battle.
